notes.title: Mutants: Genesis is officially out on PC and mobile!
notes.content:
[h1]🎉 Mutants: Genesis is officially out on PC and mobile![/h1]

It's a moment we've been waiting for: Mutants: Genesis is officially out today on Steam and also on mobile! After more than two years of early access, community feedback, tweaks, new features and content, the time has come to take the plunge.

[b]But first of all: thank you. 🙏[/b]

Thank you to everyone who joined us early, who battled bugs, shared feedback, tested absurd combos, and helped us evolve the game. You've been the pillars of this adventure, and we'd like to look back with you on everything we've achieved together.

[h2]📅 2 years of continuous evolution: how far we've come[/h2]

Since its early access launch, Mutants: Genesis has changed a lot. Here are some of the key moments that have marked this first year:

[h3]🧬 Hundreds of cards and a first-ever drop: the Pioneer Drop[/h3]

Our first massive content addition! With new cards and new mechanics, the Pioneer Drop has redefined deckbuilding possibilities and paved the way for new strategies.

[b]➡️ Read the article on Pioneer Drop [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2138570/view/3653033508006275181

[h3]💥 More intense combat with Extreme Mode[/h3]

Thought you'd seen it all in PvE? Extreme Mode has raised the bar. New bosses, more ferocious, more demanding, more... nasty. It's simple: if you've survived this, you're ready for anything.

[b]➡️ Read the Extreme Mode article[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2138570/view/3653036678838019803

[h3]⏳ Time Rifts: cooperative PvE for up to 3 players[/h3]

A game mode designed for those who like to play together. Every week, there are new Time Rifts to explore, with cooperative challenges for 2 or 3 players, exclusive rewards, and epic clashes against mutated Bosses!

[b]➡️ Read the article on Time Rifts[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2138570/view/3801661817161331029

[h3]🎂 Our first anniversary and a loyal community![/h3]

One year already! We've been celebrating with special events and rewards, but most of all with you, the community. Some have been with us since the first versions, others joined us later - but all have contributed to the growth of Mutants: Genesis.

[b]➡️ Read the anniversary article[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2138570/view/4179980031218599334

[h3]🧠 Ascension: a new story act and the arrival of Arc 2[/h3]

The story continues with Ascension, our major narrative update. New ardsc, new mechanics, new challenges. The universe of Mutants: Genesis is growing and expanding, and this is just the beginning.

[b]➡️ Read the Ascension article[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2138570/view/4226147001142488719


[h2]📱 20 May: a PC and mobile release[/h2]

The big news in version 1.0 is the availability of Mutants: Genesis on mobile!
Play wherever you want, whenever you want, in the same conditions as on PC, with full crossplay and synchronised progression.

[h3]💬 This is just the beginning[/h3]

We're a small, independent team, and every piece of feedback, every message, every bug report has a direct impact on the game. The launch, for us, isn't an end - it's the start of a new chapter.

Now that Mutants: Genesis is in your hands on PC and mobile, we can't wait to see what you create, imagine, break, and dominate.

Thank you again for your support. Thank you for your patience. Thank you for your passion.
And most of all... to your decks, Psycogs. 🧬

—
The Celsius Online team

—

notes.title: Balance Patch - V 0.7.8
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to a new balancing patchnote!

[b][h2]Objectifs[/h2][/b]

This balance patch follows the release of several new maps linked to Chapter 2, and a stabilisation of the meta after the various releases. It was therefore necessary for us to take stock of the state of the game and propose relevant changes to the various maps, particularly those linked to Chapter 2. 

___________________________________________________________________

[b][h3]New Mechanic: Exhaustion[/h3][/b]

Based on our analysis and the many feedbacks we received from the community during early access, we noticed that Support cards with draw effects were too prevalent compared to what we had initially planned. This led to a style of play that relied heavily on the use of multiple Support cards over short periods to draw large volumes of cards. In order to bring the draw down to an acceptable level without applying a direct and violent penalty on the individual potential of the draw effects, we chose to introduce a new game mechanic called Exhaustion. 

Exhaustion is an individual global counter, reset to zero at the end of your turn, and used to limit the power of certain cards and effects. Initially, only Support cards will interact with this mechanic. 

Some Support cards now have the keyword Exhaustion. This keyword indicates 2 things: 

Firstly, when you play this card, at the end of the resolution of its effects, your Exhaustion counter increases by 1. 

Secondly, the power of the card's effects will be reduced according to the Exhaustion value. 

For example: all 6 Genetic Cycling cards will be affected by this keyword. During a turn, you start your turn with 0 Depletion. You play your first Genetic Cycling and draw 2 cards. If you play a second Genetic Cycling during the same turn, you will draw one less card due to Exhaustion. 

[Cards affected by Depletion[/b]

[b][list]
[*] Genetic Cycling - Tech
[/list][/b]

Discard a Tech mutant or Gadget card: draw 2 cards.

[b][list]
[*] Genetic Cycling - Blades
[/list][/b]

Discard a Blades mutant: draw 2 cards.

[b][list]
[*] Genetic Cycling - Zoo
[/list][/b]

Discard a Zoo mutant: draw 2cards.

[b][list]
[*] Genetic Cycling - Necro
[/list][/b]

Discard a Necro mutant: draw 2 cards.

[b][list]
[*] Genetic Cycling - Space
[/list][/b]

Discard a Space mutant: draw 2 cards.

[b][list]
[*] Genetic Cycling - Mystic
[/list][/b]

Discard a Mystic mutant: draw 2 cards.

[b][list]
[*] Bio-Recycling
[/list][/b]

Sacrifice one of your uninvoked mutants: draw 2 cards.

[b][list]
[*] Astragalomancy
[/list][/b]

Remove 2 Bone cards from your Discard Pile: Draw 2 cards

[b][list]
[*] Battle Plan
[/list][/b]

If you have at least 2 mutants with an activated Tactic on your field, draw 2 cards.

[b][list]
[*] Stylish Unity
[/list][/b]

If you control at least 2 uninvoked monogen mutants, draw 2 cards.

[b][list]
[*] IEM Bomb
[/list][/b]

Discard 1 card. Inflict 1 damage then stasis 2 to all entities on your field and the opponent's field.

___________________________________________________________________

[b][h3]Downward balancing (Nerfs)[/h3][/b]

[b][list]
[*] Capacoburger
[/list][/b]

Although one of the aims of Chapter 2 was to shift the gameplay somewhat towards monogen mutants, some of the cards supporting monogen archetypes proved even more effective than expected in the hands of the community, to the point of becoming deleterious to the game. Capacoburger in particular has opened the door to combinations based on sacrifice attacks to make huge holes in the opponent's defence, bringing the ability for a mutant to inflict 4 extra points of damage during an attack, as well as collateral damage. We're therefore going to reduce the magnitude of the card's effects quite significantly. 

ATK Bonus: +2 → +1

Indigestion: No longer affects buildings. 

___________________________________________________________________

[b][h3]Buffs[/h3][/b]

[b][list]
[*] Son of the Storm
[/list][/b]

The power of this mutant is slightly lower than that of other comparable mutants, due to its limited ability to stay on the field long enough to activate its ability multiple times. We've therefore decided to increase its defensive capacity a little to make it easier for it to resist direct attacks. 

HP increase: 1/2/3/4/6 → 2/3/4/6/9 HP

[b][list]
[*] Master Oida
[/list][/b]

This mutant, which has existed since the early days of the game, is still struggling to really find its place as an offensive support mutant. We've therefore decided to increase the power of the attack boost provided by his Action ability, while at the same time reducing his already high defensive potential thanks to his Evasion ability. 

Bonus ATK: +2/3/4/5/7 -> +3/4/5/6/8

HP: 1/3/5/7/10 -> 1/2/4/6/9

[b][list]
[*] Scarlett
[/list][/b]

The heroic mutant obtainable only via temporal rifts has proved to be slightly below expectations, due to her stats being a little too low. We are therefore readjusting her attack and HP upwards. 

ATQ: 6 → 7

HP: 6 → 7

[b][list]
[*] Vital Orb
[/list][/b]

The two orbs with Reforge do not have the same purpose. One is used to force an equivalent trade in order to recover a Forged Orb, while the other is used to win a battle by surviving it. In order to make the Vital Orb more petinent in its primary role, we have chosen to increase the VP bonus it confers.  

Bonus HP conferred: +1 → +2

[b][list]
[*] Unloading Crane
[/list][/b]

The current operation of this building makes it inefficient in its role as a mass gadget generator when several Tech mutants are destroyed. To overcome this problem, we're limiting the frequency of activation, but increasing the quantity of Gadgets generated to make it more stable in its operation.  

[b][list]
[*] Recycling: 
[/list][/b]

Before: When one of your Tech Mutants is destroyed, add 1 Gadget to your hand. 

After: Once per turn, when one of your Tech Mutants is destroyed, add 2 Gadgets to your hand.   

___________________________________________________________________


That's all for this patch,

Enjoy the game,

Team Genesis

___

notes.title: Camera... ACTION!
notes.content:
Greetings Psycog!

The sixth and final part of [b]Ascension[/b] is coming out tomorrow! Time to get on stage with [b]7 Production[/b], the Entertainment corporation is ready to run the camera!

You'll face the showman Ru, the amazing actor and Psycog of Seven Production.

Ru is a real star. One of the best asset of Seven production, he is king at switching from a composed and cold demeanor to one of showman running of the most impressive and baroque spectacle in the Arena. Ru has a special link with the Mutants he controls, so special in fact that he considers them his collaborators. Are you going to be one of the main actors of his story or just an extra?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/7556f968d1d02f58f1e62a016f54f0d37d99a565.jpg[/img]

In addition to the 3 new challenges that will lead you to face Ru, you'll also be able to collect 3 new cards!


You are noted by the ETERNAL ARCHIVIST!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/6c2529c10c2d32ce233f806a9d00c07eec01b495.png[/img]

Eternal Archivist will be a key drawing engine for Action based decks. Get ready to open up your options to play!


Be still like the MONOLITH

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/e37339088672cf8a5a46df38ce77462cce0aba71.png[/img]

This Armored Guardian will be a great tank, healing every time you use an Action!


End production with the DIRECTOR’S CUT

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/fea6d1fa9f67b81ca0ca195c8b120601a16f7ed7.png[/img]

This support card offers a way to deal zone damage regarding the number of genes present on the battlefield.


In addition to these cards, you'll be able to get a new pack for those of you who love customisation! 2 new skins, a new card back and, of course, 10 capsules for Mystic fans!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/cc750645420eac0fe2489beb6dd1357c069dac7d.jpg[/img]

After resilience, it’s time to show who’s deserving to become a star of the Arena, will it be you or Ru?

We hope you enjoyed this article, and look forward to bringing you the last section of [b]Ascension[/b]! As a reminder, all the PvE content is accessible and playable for free, all you need to do is complete Chapter 1, the battle against the Simulacrum and the first five parts of [b]Ascension[/b] ;) 

Have a good day, Psycogs!

The fifth part of the Chapter 2 update: [b]Ascension[/b] is out tomorrow!  This time we're going for the stars with : [i][b]Bolshaya Sestra[/b][/i] and her futuristic inventions!

You'll have to take on the curious Natasha, Bolshaya Sestra's brilliant engineer and Psycog.

Natasha does her best to have a perfect career. Driven by curiosity and the mysteries of space, she harbours dreams of becoming an explorer of the final frontier. In the meantime, she has to win, and she's not going to give up victory so easily. The future belongs to Natasha, and you are just one step in her conquest of what lies beyond our atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/61652089438c551f88b7c0786f65e799fdb98c6c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/bba3dbcb7d8ec84e297d62eb8702583133583b40.png[/img]

Astro Surfer does what Space does best, taking advantage of the interraction of buildings: when you destroy one, you draw cards!


Wear your colours high with the Sestra Banner!

This Building card for Bolshaya Sestra will boost Building resistance for each Mono-Space Mutant you have on the board. It's time for Space to assert its dominance over the Buildings line.


In addition to these cards, you'll be able to get a new pack for those of you who love customisation! 2 new skins, a new card back and, of course, 10 capsules for Space fans!

notes.title: Balance Patch Summer 2024
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to a new balance patch!

___________________________________________________________________
[h3][b]Balancing down (Nerfs)[/b][/h3] 📉 
___________________________________________________________________

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/eef604b43bffee34fc0fa51a3805745f3b49a5a5.png[/img]

[i][b]Battle Plan[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] Battle Plan allowed Blades-Tactics decks to draw too easily. Generally speaking, we want to limit the use of cards that allow you to draw too much. The Battle Plan function has been slightly modified to allow you to draw a maximum of two cards.
[/list]

Before: For each mutant with an activated Tactics ability on your field, draw one card (max. 3).

After: If you have at least 2 mutants with an activated Tactics ability on your field, draw 2 cards. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/9cd95ab602be181e94cc6fa81d413b25885b8262.png[/img]

[i][b]Planning Table[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] Mutants with Tactics benefit too easily from this Building, which gives them power and survivability. In order to limit the impact of this card, we are removing the survivability aspect from its bonus. 
[/list]

[i]Tactical Advantage Ability:[/i]

Before: Passive - All your mutants with Tactics activated have +1 ATQ and +1 HP. 

After: Passive - All your mutants with Tactics activated have +1 ATK. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/0bfa7f6ecbb025da3d3e02c0f40a027602669672.png[/img]

[i][b]Orbital Strike[/b][/i]

[list][*] The new Heroic Support card is very powerful.We'd like to keep it being play, but reduce its damage slightly.
[/list]

Before: Discard a card: deals 5 damage to the targeted enemy mutant. 
If the target is a Heroic or Boss mutant, draw a card. 

After: Discard a card: deals 4 damage to the targeted enemy mutant. If the target is a Heroic Mutant or Boss, draw a card. 

___________________________________________________________________
[h3][b]Upward Balancing (Buffs)[/b][/h3] 📈
___________________________________________________________________

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/c2bed863ddf4ac78309776c202e163e334c95f30.png[/img]

[i][b]Reconstruction[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] This card, which allows you to exchange one building for another, is proving too costly for most decks. We've decided to add an option with Space decks to use it more effectively.
[/list]

Before: Discard a Building: Add a Building from your deck to your hand. 

After: Discard a Building or Galactic Mutant: Add a Building from your deck to your hand. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/fa441ba0746b243b4709d8031aaa69d38fc88f59.png[/img]

[i][b]Engineering Lab[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] The impact of this building was too weak to allow its use in Autorepair decks. We are increasing its effects.
[/list]

[i]Technical Revision Capability:[/i]

Before: Passive - When one of your mutants is healed by Autorepair, it gets +1 ATQ. 

After: Passive - When one of your mutants is healed by Autorepair, it gains +1 ATQ and +1 HP. 

___________________________________________________________________
[h3][b]Functional modifications (Reworks)[/b][/h3] 📊
___________________________________________________________________

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/635e3845cb7b3af720f57b46827c3dbc7eba69ca.png[/img]

[i][b]Beast[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] Sometimes too powerful, sometimes too weak, Beast's current mode of operation was struggling to find its balance. So we decided to completely redesign the mutant's kit while retaining its random, offensive side.
[/list]

Midnight Fang Ability: Removed

New ability: Howl

At Basic rank

Rush - When this mutant comes into play, a random mutant on your field gains +1 ATK until the end of the turn. 

At subsequent ranks

Evolution - When this mutant evolves, a random mutant on your field gets +1/2/3/4 ATK until end of turn.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/7a16a2fb8ab437508eb93e1ab89ac6dbb655e6fa.png[/img]

[i][b]Sorceress[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] This mutant, obtainable via temporal rifts, was lacking something to function effectively. In order to bring this one up to speed and make it playable in certain Mystic archetypes as well, we're adding an Active ability to it that will synergise with its Execution ability. 
[/list]

New ability: Explosive Sorcery

Action: Inflicts 1/1/2/2/3 damage to the targeted mutant. 

ATK : 2/3/4/6/7 → 2/3/4/5/6

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/2f02c7eea55a3ab538d4418c92857eb11a0bd15a.png[/img]

[i][b]Astragalomancy[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] In the same way as its Tactical Battle Plan counterpart, we've decided to change the way Astragalomancy works to make it easier to play, but limit the number of cards drawn by its effect. 
[/list]

Before: Remove 3 Bones from your Discard Pile to draw 3 cards.

After: Remove 2 Bones from your Discard Pile to draw 2 cards.

notes.title: The first Major Content Update is coming out!
notes.content:
Greetings Psycogs,

We are super excited to share with you a great news! Our next major content update is right around the corner! Titled: [b]Ascension[/b], it will follow up on where we left off the story during Chapter 1 and introduce new elements of lore, new fights and obviously new cards!

But before going more in depth with its content, let’s check out our Game’s Director letter to the community: 

[quote=Doc]Dear Psycogs,

On behalf of the entire Mutants: Genesis team, we would like to thank you for your unfailing support since the start of early access, your constant feedback and your constant encouragement.

Being able to talk to you and see how much you like the game, particularly on our community discord, is a very important source of motivation and encouragement for us. This first year of Early Access has been a rich one in many ways: the arrival of Time Rifts, the mobile version (iOS coming soon), the many ranked seasons in which you've fought hard, the Simulacrum (even the Extreme mode couldn't resist the most valiant among you), and above all, even if it's something less visible to you, the major work on stability and bug-fixing on the game, have made this a very beneficial year for the game, which has been able to consolidate its foundations.

Today, to celebrate the start of this second year of Early Access, the team is very proud to finally be releasing the sequel to our campaign, which you seem to be looking forward to just as much as we are: Chapter 2: Ascension.

After passing the Atika trials and being named captain of the Panakeia Junior Team, it's time for you and your two companions to get back into the thick of things. In this new arc, you'll be travelling to the 4 corners of the world to take on the biggest corporations and their champions. Each sub-section corresponds to a corporation represented by one of the game's 6 genes, and the confrontations will lead you to meet some colourful characters, learn about their personal histories, and battle them for the title of Xtrem Junior League of the Year. In this new arc, you'll learn more about the world of Mutants: Genesis, not to mention your rewards: new cards with every victory! 

We hope you enjoy this story arc and that it lives up to your expectations.

As for the sequel, we've still got plenty of surprises in store for you. If you want to know which one I'm personally most looking forward to, I invite you to re-read our last article, in which you'll find a sneak preview of the next boss you might come across after this arc 2!

To conclude this letter, I'd also like to thank and welcome all the new Psycogs who join us every day. Mutants: Genesis is above all a community game that needs its players to thrive. If you're looking for other Psycogs to chat to, or if you're looking to take on the titans, I can only recommend that you join our Discord once again.

We hope to see you soon![/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/a6dbef61e36b125be249a33f751e2ad1245ae555.jpg[/img]

So here we are guys, a new chapter opens up on the world of [i][b]Mutants: Genesis[/b][/i]! 

Let’s now dive into how this content will be released and what you can expect!

A new part of Chapter 2 will be released every 2 weeks, introducing a corporation, its leader and of course new cards, rewards and packs to get new skins or cardback! 
With 6 Genes, that’s more than 12 weeks of content coming up! Of course, a Chapter would not be complete without its boss. A special encounter that will offer a new challenge to existing and new players as well as as introducing a new Time Rift challenge!

As the new leader of the Panakeia team, you will have to travel around the world to be the very best. This will introduce you to new cards, corporation and gene specific strategies and of course, a cool fight with the leader of another team!

All new cards will be thematized around a Corporation specific gene, and so will be mono-gene! You’ll be able to collect 2 new mutants and a building or support card per Gene. So 18 new cards in total!

In addition to all of this, you will be able to purchase one of our Sponsorship Pack including:

[list]
[*] 2 Skins
[*] An exclusive card back
[*] 10 Gene specific capsules to get the new cards
[*] 
[/list]

[i]A.S.A also told us that a Mega Sponsorship Bundle will be available with a special discount![/i]

As you can see, there is lot to unpack in the coming weeks, and we are very excited to tell you that the first part of this Chapter will be out on the 17th of July! 

We’ll get the ball rolling with the Zoo gene and its corporation: [b]Noah’s Ark[/b]!

Stay tuned for an article detailing this first release. We’ll see you soon Psycogs, get ready to the biggest content update to come yet!

notes.title: Mutants: Genesis 1st birthday!
notes.content:
Dear Psycogs,

Mutants: Genesis is celebrating its first anniversary!

To mark the occasion, we'd like to thank players for their loyalty and look back on a fantastic year.

Mutants: Genesis has had a great first year in early access, with many evolutions. And although some features have taken a little longer than expected, feedback from the community, with particularly enthusiastic and committed Psycogs, has greatly contributed to the improvement of Mutants: Genesis (and warmed our hearts!).

[h3]Here's a quick recap of the year:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Mutant: Genesis now has [b]over 1500 members[/b] on its Discord server (click on the button at the end of the article to join!).
[*] Ranked Seasons release
[*] Ability to craft cards of your choice
[*] Time Rifts release
[*] 200K games played
[*] 2K simulacrum defeated
[/list]

For our anniversary, we've pulled out all the stops!

[h3]Anniversary Pack[/h3]

From [b]May 10 to 31[/b], a special anniversary pack is available in the store, containing a special Card Back featuring Spartac, the heroic mutant who accompanied all our announcements at the start of the game, as well as a new Skin for your Psycog!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/ba0d9a6cb6c46edbb405e43248e6b650d474419c.jpg[/img]

[h3]Birthday Pack[/h3]

You loved them, but some of you could not get them on time. For our birthday, we're bringing them back for a limited time. Seasonal skins are available again until May 31st! Don't miss this second chance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/674651fb6db70957233556670a5e6fa7b348eb83.jpg[/img]

[h3]A special gift code for players[/h3]

There is no way we would have a left you without a gift! Here's a “little” redeem code, with the best reward we ever made: an free Ultra Capsule and 500 credits!!!

[b]GEN1STBDAY[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/73b053637695cd725249f63f1ea6b1ae939e0058.jpg[/img]

Players, thank you for following us all along. Thank you for being so active on our Discord, we trully appreciated all of your feedbacks! We can’t wait to show you what we have prepared for the coming year.

notes.title: What's Next?
notes.content:
As announced at the end of the last year, we've just released the Mobile version for Android and now that we have, many of you are no doubt wondering what we have planned for future updates of the game.

[h3]iOS Version[/h3]

Players with iPhone should soon be able to join the other Psycogs, as we're in the process of finalizing this version, which requires a few more adaptations. Thank you all for your patience.

[h3]A Touch of Emotion[/h3]

Many players have told us that they'd like to have more ways of communicating and expressing themselves during games, and the first step towards this is on the way: emotes. We're going to introduce a system of emotes that will make it a little easier to communicate your emotions in the middle of a game. 

These emotes will be based on the various characters you've already met in the course of the game, such as Victor and Zula.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/7dc5d0bfa89a65af17083644bfc952bc9b46bf7b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/9ff17eed797a83ba80c768456ffb577e1bfef6bb.png[/img]

We plan to add new emotes regularly as patches are released, and they may also feature new characters appearing in future chapters. Once new emotes are released, you'll be able to make your own selection of emotes available in the middle of combat, from the list of those you've unlocked. This will take place in a dedicated interface outside duels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/6075148dee311bc700200a7da83cd4c2baf199fa.png[/img]

Regarding this, let's move on to the next section, concerning the upcoming story chapter.

[h3]Junior Mutants League[/h3]
 
At the end of the first chapter at the Panakéia orphanage, you were selected as Captain of your team after defeating Boris and Zula. Now it's time to test your skills against the other teams in the Junior Mutants League. The 6 most powerful teams in the league await you, each linked to one of the megacorporations at the centre of this universe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/64c3e5c117e1e4d72000c4c839321b1945e141d8.jpg[/img]

Will you be able to defeat them and become Junior Mutants League Champion? Whatever happens, Uncle Vic will be there to support you, Boris and Zula in the challenges ahead. 

This second chapter, which is longer than the previous one, will take place all over the world and will allow you to meet and face the other major teams in the league, while discovering their respective Captains, each with their own specialty.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/706e562d6088ebae7cd7af69d2e7b562774a97b8.jpg[/img]

We've included much more lore about the universe in this second chapter, now that you've left the Panakéia Orphanage. And to reinforce the atmosphere of each of the major megacorporations in the Mutants: Genesis universe, we'll also be adding arenas specific to each Champion, here are two of them:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/fb429a1c05085cbfaee3b16eaf3d3b04bda6d1d6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/3ba480f86ce5c461c01c9c58283229d0b37d9261.png[/img]

All these new battles will be accompanied by new unlockable cards, usable in all game modes, with new mutants specializing in a single gene. 

This chapter will be made available very soon, over the course of 6 patches, each containing one of the Junior Mutants League teams. All those fights will be playable in the order of your choice.

This chapter focuses on battles against other characters, but that won't be the only threat. There will also be a Boss to face.

[h3]Titanic Threats[/h3]

Following the release of the content for the second chapter, we'll be unlocking access to the second Boss fight of Mutants: Genesis, which will take place in its own 2-level dungeon, to be completed in cooperation with other players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/8f5a06a5a9bbb87b262f20e6d8c59a944d1b3d58.jpg[/img]

This dungeon will be accessible directly from the map in the second chapter, and will require you to have progressed far enough in the story. 

Don't expect this new boss to be as kind to you as the Simulacrum was - this time the Titan will be a strange, savage creature ready to destroy everything in its path, and the dungeon is full of deadly dangers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/028eaab501a39935995c6ebf709e26e5dbc0c8b5.jpg[/img]

This new Titan will feature all-new mechanics, and exclusive rewards obtainable in its dedicated dungeon: new maps and an exclusive Skin. It will also alternate with the Simulacrum in the Time Rifts.

[h3]The community expands[/h3]

We'd like to thank all the new Psycogs who have joined the Mutants: Genesis universe, and we hope to see you all evolve along with our characters and the mutants you control in battle in all future patches. 

This is just a teaser of the upcoming features that will be coming to the game, and we'll be sure to tell you more as they get closer to their respective releases.

Oh and here is a little gift, a Redeem Code:

[h3]TOEEANKENK[/h3]

notes.title: Balance Patch - V 0.6.14
notes.content:
Hello everyone and welcome to a new balance patch!

[h2][b]Objectives[/b][/h2]

This patch, which takes place several months after the previous one, has enabled us to study the evolution of the meta over a longer period, in order to allow it a longer phase of self-regulation. As a result, we were able to see a high degree of stability in the Blades Orbs archetype at the top, with a few minor excesses on the Zoo side. We also saw a slump in the Space and Mystics decks. 

[h3][b]Balancing down (Nerfs)[/b][/h3] 📉 
___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Forged Orb[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] The addition of Forged Orbs in previous drops allowed one Orbs archetype to work very, if not too effectively, particularly play for a One-Turn Kill. However, this was not the intended purpose of these orbs. So we decided to limit their power by removing their ATK bonus. 
[/list]

[b]Before:[/b] The equipped mutant has +1 ATK and +1 HP. 

[b]After:[/b] The equipped mutant has +1 HP. 


[i][b]El Gringo[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] This pistolero is far too fast in both his attacks and his growth, allowing him to fire one shot after another and take very large quantities of EVO without risk. We've therefore decided to limit his growth rate and adjust his stats accordingly. 
[/list]

[b]Evolve curve:[/b] 1/2/3/4 → 2/3/4/5

[b]EVO:[/b] 1/2/3/4/6 → 1/3/4/6/9

[b]ATK:[/b] 2/3/4/5/7 → 2/4/5/6/8

[b]PV:[/b] 2/3/4/5/7 → 2/4/5/6/8


[i][b]Skirmish Tower[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] The Orb Support Building has become too powerful with the emergence of Forged Orbs, as large numbers of them can be played via card effects. We're therefore adjusting the power of the Building to take account of this greater influx of Orbs. 
[/list]

[b]First Strike Capacity: [/b]

[b]Before:[/b] Passive - When you equip an Orb on a mutant, the Equipped mutant gets +2 ATK this turn.

[b]After:[/b] Passive - When you equip an Orb on a Mutant, the Equipped Mutant gets +1 ATK this turn.


[i][b]Mecharachnidian[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] The heroic spider is at it again. We've analysed how the card is used, and we've decided to limit its direct impact a little by reducing its base stats slightly to make it more vulnerable and less dangerous. 
[/list]

[b]ATQ:[/b] 6 → 5

[b]HP:[/b] 6 → 5

___________________________________________________________________

[h3][b]Upward Balancing (Buffs)[/b][/h3] 📈 

___________________________________________________________________


[i][b]Behemoth[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] The gigantic alien had a power with an alternating progression between an increase in attack bonus and HP bonus, making some of its ranks more effective defensively and others offensively. 
[/list]

[b]Heavy Security Ability:[/b]

[b]Before:[/b] Architecture - For each Building on your field, this mutant has +1/1/2/2/3 ATQ and +0/1/1/2/3 HP.

[b]After:[/b] Architecture - For each Building on your field, this mutant has +1/1/2/2/3 ATQ and +1/1/2/2/3 VP.


[i][b]Gargantua[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] This member of the trio formed with Tengu and Thor was less powerful than his fellows, being more specialised against buildings. As its damage potential is too limited, we're increasing the overall damage of its ability. 
[/list]

[b]Meteor Smash ability:[/b] 

[b]Damage:[/b] 1/2/3/4/5 → 2/3/4/5/7


[i][b]Lichlock[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] This mutant's drawing power was slightly underestimated, given that the mutant takes time to incubate. We are therefore increasing its draw ability at all ranks. 
[/list]

[b]Forbidden Knowledge ability: [/b]

[b]Before:[/b] Testament - When this mutant is destroyed, draw 1/2/3/4/5 cards.

[b]After:[/b] Testament - When this mutant is destroyed, draw 2/3/4/5/6 cards.

___________________________________________________________________

[h3][b]Functional modifications (Reworks)[/b][/h3] 📊

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Reforge Keyword[/b]

Both Power Orb and Health Orb cards feature the Reforge mechanic, which allowed the player to draw a card when the equipped mutant was destroyed. However, this mechanic allowed you to cycle through your deck far too quickly in combination with the other cards dedicated to supporting Orbs. We've therefore decided to bring forward a change to the Reforge ability on these two cards, which will allow them to produce a Forged Orb instead of drawing. 

This will ensure a degree of stability in the way the cards linked to Orbs work, by ensuring that the card obtained when the Reforge ability is triggered is necessarily an Orb, without giving these orbs an overpowered advantage over the others. 

[i][b]Reforge[/b][/i]

[b]Before:[/b] When the mutant to which this orb is equipped is destroyed, draw 1 card.

[b]After:[/b] When the mutant to which this orb is equipped is destroyed, add a Forged Orb to your hand.

___________________________________________________________________


That's all for this patch, and don't forget it'll be available on Wednesday, March 13th!

Enjoy the game,

Team Genesis

notes.title: What's next?
notes.content:
Hello Psycogs everywhere!

As the end of the year approaches and the first Time Rifts have made their appearance, it is the moment chosen by our Game Director, Arthur Riolland, to inform you in detail about what we are planning for the beginning of 2024.

[quote=Arthur]Dear Psycogs,

First of all, on behalf of the entire Mutants: Genesis team, I'd like to thank you for our first year together.

What a journey it has been since the demo at the Steam Neo Fest in February...  There was the Early Access release in May, the first ranked seasons, the introduction of the Hard and Extreme modes of the Dungeon, lots of new cards, and finally, the release of the Time Rifts!

This year has been very important for us and for Mutants: Genesis, and we are extremely grateful for the welcome you've given us and the passion you have for our game.

As the end of the year approaches, it was important for me to touch base with all of you to tell you where we are, and where we are all going together with Mutants: Genesis.

As previously announced, the Time Rifts were the last major update of the year. Today, our teams' priority is to expand the game's reach, and to that end we're now focusing all our efforts on the release of Mutants: Genesis on iOS, Android and as a standalone Windows version, which means porting the game to all three platforms.

It's a long-term project, started a long time ago, but which, to be brought to completion, requires the full attention of our teams. 

Therefore, unfortunately, there won't be any new content added to the game until these three versions are released.

Where do we stand today, and when can we expect these versions?

Well, actually, we're pretty close!

Internally, we can already play Mutants: Genesis on our Android and iOS phones.

However, as you probably know, the devil is in the detail and there are still a few important things we need to do before we can start having you test these versions. In any case, we will be keeping you regularly informed of our progress.

As for a release date, it is still too early to say, but we are confident in our ability to have you play Mutants: Genesis on your phones in the first quarter of 2024.

What's next?

You've been waiting a long time (and so have we)! Arc 2 and a new dungeon, with its new PvE boss, are currently being finalized, and as soon as our attention is less focused on mobile ports and the standalone version for Windows, the continuation of the Mutants: Genesis' story will be revealed, with lots of new challenges and, we hope, lots of new Psycogs to overcome them with!

I wanted to thank you once again for your unwavering support since the launch of this Early Access, and we are all extremely excited to continue sharing this adventure with you.

2024 will be a rich and crucial year for Mutants: Genesis, so stay tuned!

3, 2, 1, deploy the Psycores!

Arthur Riolland.[/quote]

notes.title: Psycog 101 - Buildings
notes.content:
Hello once again friends of knowledge!

[quote=Victor]Huh.. What?[/quote]

I just wanted to add a creative twist to my greeting. So, welcome back, Psycogs, to a brand-new Psycog 101, where we'll discuss something we haven't yet covered: buildings!

[quote=Victor]Oh I love to smash them! But it is true that they are very useful... Wait a second though, what if today's students are new here?[/quote]

You're right! My name is R. , I'm a friend of Victor and a former Student of Panakeïa. But, my professionnal carreer might not be as interesting as our estimeed professor here!

[quote=Victor]Oh you flatterer...[/quote]

As for today's course, we will not talk about every buildings in the game as it would be slightly tedious. Still, there are a few cards that you'll get quite early in the game that we want to highlight!

[quote=Victor]Yep! And you and I even came up with categories to fit them in![/quote]

Without further ado, let's dive in it!

We can start with what we call : [i]Walls[/i]. Those are defensive buildings with the intent to protect your Psycore.

[quote=Victor]And they come in 3 flavours![/quote]

You can't eat Buildings Victor, but you're right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/5050a225a347beb02879545966e70ba65b3664d5.png[/img]

[b]Defensive Shield[/b] is your standard big HP, bulky defender. It is supposed to be strong and require ressources and commitment from your opponent to be delt with.

[quote=Victor]I personally prefer the destructive power of the Void Turret![/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/4b887613586dfd19a83185332b522058c9a423ca.png[/img]

This Building will deal 3 damages to a random Mutant on your opponent's board. Making it a difficult choice : do I accept the potential trade or not? 
On my side, I'm more of a [b]Terror Tower[/b] type of guy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/5a25d0342468680ca24c16df960e48fa6667e7b2.png[/img]

[quote=Victor]Ah, that one wreaked havoc on my Zoo mutants back in the day... A -2 Attack on the entire board is no laughing matter.[/quote]

This specific building will work miracle if placed at the right time to punish an opponent that expanded too quickly.

[quote=Victor]When walls are not enough though, you can always use other tools to get an advantage![/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/a0dc972e500b9c1b47395c721e38d5a2a87ebe7b.png[/img]

[b]Incubator Pods[/b] are essential when your deck is heavy on advanced mutants. Be careful though as if they are destroyed, your mutant is lost!

[quote=Victor]When it comes to spawning mutants though, I can't get enough of my [b]Old Printer[/b]![/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/3ef5b385fa6f5babf1c7002c6997c17c2b77e60b.png[/img]

Not surprising, but it's true that it's a great tool for gaining a numerical advantage by generating an additional starter mutant at the start of your turn.  Still, if you manage to grab a copy of [b]Laser Printer[/b], it is a valuable upgrade. It offers more value if it stays on the board, but be aware, it also gives more XP to the opponent!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/c29f11633e09c22b07f82407d016081fc150bee1.png[/img]

Now, building can also be agressive tools.

[quote=Victor]That's right, have you ever heard the sound of missiles crashing into your opponent's Psycore? It's crisp![/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/3531bafecd5c8e025b57808f98dc789ea0d1cdb2.png[/img]

And [b]Missile Turret[/b] is the perfect card to do just that, every turns it deals 2 damages, making it a dangerous affair that must be dealt with when settled on board.

[quote=Victor]We do have my favourite category of buildings to talk about though, Accelerators![/quote]

Accelerators are building that will help you generate card advantage, a concept we discussed in previous articles by drawing more cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/47a2bf46f54790a91ab02d66f36a315d28e3022e.png[/img]

[b]Data Bank[/b] is your standard high risk, high reward type of card. By placing it you can generate 2 more cards next turn.

[quote=Victor]If it doesn't get destroyed though.[/quote]

Exactly! But if on the other hand you want a sure draw, [b]Data Fuse[/b] allows you to draw and protect your other buildings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/9fffe90c33f9974568c0fede8b4e2bdc31116d4f.png[/img]

But you have to keep in mind that it has less drawing power than its counterpart, it's basically cycling itself.

[quote=Victor]You play one, you get one![/quote]

Finally we have another very nice pick in the form of the [b]World Tree[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/b75df031221414e3fa92f227f3601cb25a00a686.png[/img]

[quote=Victor]Easily one of the first cards I recommend crafting! It's a bit bulky and if protected correctly will give you a ton of value![/quote]

Still, if its destroyed, the XP reward for your opponent is very important.

Obviously, there are a lot of different buildings that exist and most can fit in a lot of decks, you can even build some around them!

[quote=Victor]Some buildings will for example be great in Zoo decks as they will reward evolution![/quote]

Play around with them, experiment! Creativity is often rewarded in Mutants: Genesis!

As for us, we'll see you later, have a great day Psycogs!

notes.title: Balance Patch Season 4
notes.content:
Hello Psycogs!

Here's the balancing patch that will be released on Wednesday, November 22. Here are a few words from the Dev team to help you find out more, as well as the list of Buffs and Nerfs. 

Let's get started!


[h2][b]Objectives[/b][/h2]

In this patch, we've chosen to rebalance certain archetypes that had a few too many options for inflicting an OTK (One-Turn Kill, a combination of cards and actions to reduce the opponent's Psycore HP to 0 in a single turn) on the opponent and preparing for the release of new cards. In particular, the archetypes linked to Summoning had options that were a little too effective for the difficulty of setting them up. 

[h3][b]Balancing down (Nerfs)[/b][/h3] 📉 

___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Mephisto[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] The demonic mutant has too much defensive capacity, as he uses summons to get better stats and his Evasion ability. We've decided to make it targetable again in standard situations. 
[/list]
[b]Evasion keyword:[/b] Removed

___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Battle Plan[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] The support card for Mutants with Tactics has a power cap that is a little too high given that it has no cost. Rather than adding a cost to this card, we prefer to limit its excesses by adding a limit to the number of cards drawn.  
[/list]
[b]Draw effect:[/b] Limited to 3 cards. 

___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Mass Cannon[/b][/i]
[i]Like the previous card, the Mass Cannon has too high a power cap, given that the card is mainly used as a tool to end a game. We are therefore limiting its power to a maximum of 6 damage[/i].

[b]Damage inflicted by its effect[/b]: Limited to 6 damage. 

___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Bio Recycling[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] The Bio Recycling card is a little too easy to use by sacrificing summons, so we've decided to limit its use to non-summoned mutants. 
[/list]

[b]Before:[/b] Destroy one of your mutants: Draw 2 cards.

[b]After:[/b] Destroy one of your non-summoned mutants: Draw 2 cards.
___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Pandavinci[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] The little painter panda proved to be a little too powerful in his defensive capacities in pvp. We have therefore decided to add a negative counterpart to his summoning. 
[/list]

[b]EVO given by Shinigami[/b] : 0 → 1

___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Sun-Duke[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Mutant Squad Commander Heroic was a little too effective on his own compared to his incubation time. We're therefore reducing the bonus he gets depending on the other mutants with Squad in the field. 
[/list]

[b]Fleet Commander[/b] ability: 

[b]Before[/b]: This mutant has +2 ATK and +2 HP for each mutant with Squad on your field.  

[b]After[/b ]: This mutant has +1 ATK and +1 HP for each mutant with Squad on your field.  

___________________________________________________________________

[h3][b]Upward Balancing (Buffs)[/b][/h3] 📈 

___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Cerberus[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] The Soul Devouring Hellhound was sorely lacking in base power, so we've decided to increase its attack value at all ranks. 
[/list]

[b]Stats change: [/b]

[b]Attack[/b] : 1/3/4/6/7 → 2/4/5/8/9

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Big Medpack[/b]
[list]
[*] This multi-target healing card had too little ability to heal compared to single-target alternatives such as the Intermediate Medkit.  We have decided to raise its heal value to make it more relevant in its role.
[/list]

[b]Heal[/b] : 4 → 6

___________________________________________________________________

[h3][b]Functional modifications (Reworks)[/b][/h3] 📊

___________________________________________________________________
 
[i][b]Dreadnought[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] The support ship of the Squad archetype was not able to function in the way we wanted in the current game environment. So we decided to reorient its operation as a major mutant of the Squad archetype, with the ability to fetch other mutants in your deck, while retaining the ability to attack
[/list]
[b]New stats[/b]

ATK: 7 → 7

HP: 8 → 7

[b]Abilities[/b]

Armor Ability 2: Retained

Squad Ability: Retained

Support Platform Ability: Removed

Broadcast Orders Ability: Removed

Dual Core Ability added

Quick Teleport Ability added:

Action, Discard a Tech or Space mutant, or a Gadget card: Search your Deck for a non-Heroic mutant with Squad and put it into play. 

___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Strength in Numbers[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] The support card for the Summon archetype gave a little too much direct impact and had too much OTK potential early in the game. We've therefore decided to revise the way it works to limit its short-term power. From now on, the card only gives +1 ATK to all your mutants, but this bonus persists after the end of the turn for your Summoned mutants. 
[/list]

[b]Before:[/b] Each mutant you control gets +1 ATK until end of turn. Each Summoned mutant gets an additional +1 ATK.

[b]After:[/b] Each non-Summoned mutant you control gets +1 ATK until the end of the turn. Each Summoned mutant you control gets +1 permanent ATK instead. 

___________________________________________________________________

[i][b]Zeus[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] The god of lightning and king of Olympus was in his current form too powerful in the centre of certain OTK decks. We've therefore decided to completely overhaul his Divine Punishment ability and reorient it around an effect more related to his name, with the aim of punishing opposing actions, rather than encouraging the use of multiple cards with no possible opposing response. 
[/list]

[b]Divine Punishment[/b] Ability: 

Before: Whenever you or your opponent plays a card, this mutant deals 1 damage to each opposing Building and Psycore. 

After: Each time your opponent plays a card, this mutant inflicts 2 damage to each opposing Building and Psycore. 

___________________________________________________________________


That's all for this patch, and don't forget it'll be available on Wednesday, November 22!

Enjoy the game,

Team Genesis.

Greetings Psycogs!

This is the last of our Articles about the [b]Time Rifts[/b], which will be released on [b] November 8[/b]!

We will cover the Shop this time, as well as the new cards coming with this update!

[h3][b]THE TIME SHOP[/b][/h3]

Once you manage to beat any of the Weekly Time Rifts, you will be able to collect Rift Shards that will be specific to the minor mutation you have faced.

Those currencies will then allow you to buy multiple things like exclusive cosmetics and cards. There are 5 different Rift Shards and some items, including some exclusive and exciting cosmetics, will require Shards of multiple types!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/5790003c73604d2cc10a952e44bfa08c9e0b2231.png[/img]

[h3][b]NEW CARDS[/b][/h3]

Talking about cards, we have 7 of them joining the pool of Mutants: Genesis!

Let's introduce each of them with a quick commentary from our Game Director, Arthur "Docjackhal"!

[b]Son of the Storm[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/02ee57204b79584497a4aca81d4b29eeea283a42.png[/img]

This new basic mutant is an essential asset in new stasis-based decks. Capable of sniping any target on your own and your allies' terrain each time they undergo a new stasis charge, Son of the Storm is a key mutant to protect.

You'll need to defeat Titans altered by the Electrostatic mutation to obtain it.


[b]Buffalor[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/4cf09bf7c4f072b02d943f9c2837da165a1637e6.png[/img]

This monstrous buffalo zombie is imbued with the Radioactive mutation, and will automatically disintegrate all opposing mutants whose attack reaches 0 or less. A new alternative way of dominating arenas.

You'll need to defeat titans altered by the Radioactive mutation to obtain it.


[b]Stellarian Lithominer[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/59780c83db549e70efa3f4bf6371da3a5d5db187.png[/img]

A veritable building smashing machine, it will devastate the opposing side of the arena every time you equip it with an orb or play a building.

You'll need to defeat titans altered by the Seismic mutation to get it.


[b]Sorceress[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/c6341cfec5bc1b088b2b273d0f6577b598d6da9f.png[/img]

An evil sorceress who can summon an army of zombies to protect herself. Hidden behind your other mutants, she'll wait for the fateful moment to strike and flood your opponent with a horde of the living dead.

[b]Data Snail[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/1dd7a7de37092a07c0463575bc6027c52d989d0d.png[/img]

[b]Singularity Wizard[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/ef92b1e3885a1aeecd9760dac7ad491ed3e8c03f.png[/img]

This powerful magician can permanently erase an opposing mutant every turn. It's enough to give you a definitive advantage over your opponents and send them off into space.
You'll need to defeat numerous titans altered by the Electrostatic, Radioactive and Explosive mutations to obtain it.


[b]Scarlett[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/2a7c40212869c7a942fa52ee42638523fcf1eb6c.png[/img]

Finally, the terrifying Scarlett enters the arena. A real asset to the Tactics decks and the Bones decks, her ability to survive and generate bones is sure to have a powerful impact in duels.
You'll need to defeat numerous titans altered by the Seismic, Necroplague and Explosive mutations to obtain it.

notes.title: Time Rifts: Mutations
notes.content:
Greetings Psycogs!

In a serie of two articles, we'll be detailing our next major update: [b]the Time Rifts[/b], coming up on the [b]8th of November[/b]!

Our first article is about Mutations which are the key elements of this new PvE mode. Titans (or bosses) will be available to challenge in a weekly rotation of both an Inferior or Superior Rift, resetting each Monday.

The Inferior Rift will have the Titan affected by one of the Minor Mutations whereas the Superior Rift will get both a Minor Mutation and a Superior One. 

To unlock this new PvE challenge, you'll have to have defeated the Weekly Boss in Normal first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/5e896b1e3ce9b598909c4635147cea344ef46a4c.png[/img]

[h3][b]INFERIOR MUTATIONS[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/9a712d103ee9c57d288b11513eea9a351efc5706.png[/img]

Let's start with one you'll recognize through its blue hue and electrical surrounding: THE ELECTROSTATIC MUTATION. Here are the effects of this mutation:

At the end of the turn of the players and of the boss, a random mutant or building on the opponent's board suffers Stasis 3.

Additionally, when a mutant or a building in stasis is destroyed, all the player's mutants suffer as much damages as the number of Stasis stacks.

You'll have to keep an eye on who has Stasis and play around it in order not to trigger devastating chains of destructions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/d310ffca14113df8dda5eea1abf7e61adb306713.png[/img]

You then have THE RADIOACTIVE MUTATION!

This one will be terrible for Mutant heavy decks:

At the end of the player's turn, all opposing mutants suffer -1 ATK.
When a mutant has 0 ATK it is automatically destroyed and this is not affected by Stasis!

Once again, purification effects will be key as well as making sure your Mutants do not reach 0 Attack!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/4bac6ba12a65c5b8df53c6481ed96ae0e2711841.png[/img]

THE SEISMIC MUTATION is sure to make each player quake!

Each time a building comes into play, all non-Psycore buildings take 2 damage, and the player who played the building takes 2 damage. But in order to put players on a timer, at the start of each boss's turn, the Psycores each take 2 damage, dealing a whooping 6 damages at 3 players!

Buildings will have to be limited with this mutation and you'll have to go fast in order not to lose to the seismic waves!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/b9fba976d716bde4e5478b279c61167eaad5e01c.png[/img]

If earthquakes weren't your thing, you'll have THE NECROPLAGUE MUTATION to deal with! This one is quite simple:

When a mutant is destroyed, summon 1 basic Zombie for the boss. Don't be (too) afraid, the Zombie won't summon another Zombie but still it's very easy to get swamped under the undead!

Trades will have to be thoughtful and efficient for you to survive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/59d0651b1eb58cf9dc9d0401708cd0fd05d2bdb9.png[/img]

This is another simple effect: THE DETONATING MUTATION !

When a mutant or building is destroyed on a board, it explodes and inflicts 1 damage to the entire board and the opposing board.

When you are against this mutation, you have to make sure not to trigger a chain reaction of explosive proportions. So you have to make the proper choice between destroying mutants or attacking the boss!

But that's not all, if you face the Superior Rifts, you'll have to deal with a combo of a Minor Mutation and Major one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/6c08423e309ce3695586839b75d1ba6e6ae1ec88.png[/img]

[h3][b]MAJOR MUTATIONS[/b][/h3]

Major Mutations transform the challenge of Time Rifts to make it more difficult. In addition to Minor Mutations, they can cause very interesting twists on the fights!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/4262e5a0c7250cebd96ccae8343beb1ea79f760e.png[/img]

The Titan now has armour, but wait! Its Mutants too. This makes every Trade more difficult as things are more tough, needing you to have a harder hit force.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/38a1680fa6f5228c979eb6dfffa14c83aebc9d06.png[/img]

All Mutants from an Enraged Titan will have +2 ATK. Now imagine this with the NECROPLAGUE MUTATION and you will realize how dangerous it can be. Just like the Metalic Titan, it will make you think about trades!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/0c439bcfba0a339979d827c3916d4b7c01db2b2f.png[/img]

When the Titan is Colossal, it has +100% HP. Making it twice as resistant. This will cause multiple abilities to trigger several times. Rushing it down is even more difficult and what could be a sprint fight becomes an enduring one!


Here are all the Mutations from the new Time Rifts! As you can see, this will bring us to a total of 15 different combos for Superior Rifts! A real weekly challenge that we hope you will enjoy.

The Genesis Team

notes.title: Psycog 101: Psycores
notes.content:
Hello Psycogs! We are back for yet another Psycog 101!

Victor is here as well, and oh boy is he...

[quote=Victor]"Excited! I. AM. Excited to be here with you all haha!"[/quote]

Today's subject are Psycores, a staple and unmissable view in the Arena!

[quote=Victor]"Did you know they also give you an Ephemeral Mutant each turn that we call Starter?"[/quote]

Ahem... yes? Yes I did, Victor, but thank you for the reminder.

[quote=Victor]"When you are building your decks, you get to choose which Psycore to use alongside the deck's main Gene, and the best Psycores are obviously Zoo because it is my favourite gene."[/quote]

You know what? We'll indulge you this time Victor and start with Zoo first!

[quote=Victor]"NOW YOU KNOW HOW TO TALK TO ME LAD!"[/quote]

As for all genes, there are 2 Psycores available at the moment. And we'll be introducing each of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/803702cc040cd33c73f768d52a0899bdc3f32dbf.png[/img]

[b][i]ZOO A // Code Name: [/i]ARK REX[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/0eeba7af349050d8e58c6d2a2a05b2a4da3f80ab.png[/img]

[quote=Victor]"This is how I fell in love with Zoo! It is the home of the beautiful Beast."[/quote]

Yes, this very popular Starter has seen a lot of use in the recent Ranked Season. If you are looking to build an agressive and very zoo-like in spirit deck, the Ark Rex might be the best option for you.

[b][i]ZOO B // Code Name: [/i]ARK GATOR[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/d918f006ec2a624c3b1ef94a1225a0bdba22e31c.png[/img]

We go from a hairy Psycore to a scaly one with the Gator Psycore! This one introduces a different starter. 

[quote=Victor]"Evolution is the key word with this Psycore, its starter is tough and helps your whole board, including itself, evolve fast!"[/quote]

Evolution and random agression are the basis of the Zoo Psycores, we should now take a look at the sky with Space Psycores!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/e741f9d21f08524185536aba6d551585e95e4f89.png[/img]

[b][i]SPACE A // Code Name:[/i] SESTRA VEGA[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/cadb3214a6d2055e6f5ea81fae95799ecc462deb.png[/img]

Sestras are specialists of what lies beyond our world's atmosphere and are also very talented at dealing with buildings!

[quote=Victor]"And this Psycore offers just that, a tremendously punishing little alien that will become a huge threat if buildings are present on your opponent's side!"[/quote]

The next Psycore is made especially to catter to Psycogs who are fond of Squads.

[b][i]SPACE B // Code Name:[/i] SESTRA ANTARES[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/2ff2d247609247b63a413d94e564736f347f87c5.png[/img]

[quote=Victor]"I'm going to be honest, I always liked Squad mutants."[/quote]

But aren't they usually lacking in the fur department for you to like them?

[quote=Victor]"Have you seen Sgt Pandamonium?"[/quote]

Oh right. Well, the Sestra Antares Psycore is perfect for those who want to develop a strategy around Squads. Its starter does not have a lot of stats but enjoy the keyword that allows it to get various buffs!

I think it's time to take a look at other weapon specialists: Blades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/cfb9a2ad5981076af589c9264e8cd86cd1fc58bc.png[/img]

[b][i]BLADES A // Code Name:[/i] TRIOMPHE BASTION[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/9ecdc41076353699b0df7605d1db28af30298dc8.png[/img]

The Bastion is a classic for all strategy fans.

[quote=Victor]"You got to admit that the Warrior is carrying one hell of an axe. And the Tactic keyword to go with it, of course."[/quote]

This is the Psycore to use if your deck strategy revolves around the Tactic keyword as the starter will help trigger effects linked to it.

[b][i]BLADES B // Code Name:[/i] TRIOMPHE CITADEL[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/f8d6c8c7bbf75930d1ca97f2ac70d8ec4c96b821.png[/img]

[quote=Victor]"Now, if you're looking for a best seller in the Psycog Community..."[/quote]

You got to take a look at the Triomphe Citadel indeed. Its Starter, Barbarian, is a fearsome opponent when geared with some of the sweet orbs that are a specialty of the Triomphe Corporation.

[quote=Victor]"Did you hear something?"[/quote]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/df8a43b208aee1f67e0a0c42b7d9fa52531d905e.png[/img]

[b][i]NECRO A // Code Name:[/i] CAPACOFLESH[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/43b49374b79690ccde6f05bd739030037b775466.png[/img]

Well, the Necro Gene Capacoflesh Psycore is an explosive one.

[quote=Victor]"Oh lad, I see what you did there. Yes, Zombies made through this terrifying machine are a pain to deal with."[/quote]

Because they explode.

[quote=Victor]"Ahem..."[/quote]

Okay, I'm stopping with the boom-bastic jokes. This Psycore is a great base for those of you that want to start building a deck that functions well with Last Wish triggers. If you have a bone to pick though...

[b][i]NECRO B // Code Name:[/i] CAPACOBONES[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/0c6f70d30aa0d78945ac76e10d13c6ac10ae3623.png[/img]

[quote=Victor]"Couldn't help it, could you?"[/quote]

I know hahaha! You gotta crack your skull from time to time. Anyways, the Capacobones will function best with, well... Bones. So if you need a Starter that help to fill this discard of yours, it's the way to take!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/234c6200a5759521a2a3988667d03e52ec6af4bd.png[/img]

[b][i]TECH A // Code Name:[/i] I.E.M B0T[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/367d6ffee86dc209ef3e0fc1f86f1b03480c7ed4.png[/img]

01101000 01100101 01110010 01100101 00100000 01100001 01110010 01100101 00100000 01110100 01101000 01100101 00100000 01110100 01100101 01100011 01101000

[quote=Victor]"Are you alright?"[/quote]

Always, always! Have you seen the Bots produced by this Psycore in the Arena, Victor?

[quote=Victor]"They are so efficient. Great stats, a shame about their unstability though."[/quote]

It's not a shame but a purposeful choice to balance this great creation from I.E.M. Psycogs that look for fast agression and a way to trigger Autorepair effects will find themselves delighted with this Psycore!

[b][i]TECH B // Code Name:[/i] I.E.M BTY[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/2b2a011d8cf393d1fc27a8c2ff1aafa20a13b71c.png[/img]

[quote=Victor]"Now, if you want to play around with one of the tech gene specialty which is Parts this is the best one to choose and use. It will provide a starter that will be a source of regular Parts in your hand."[/quote]

Thank you Victor, that was very detailed.

[quote=Victor]"I forget something?"[/quote]

Nothing my friend, except for the fact that we are now going to talk about my favourite gene: Mystic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/8caba9f980ef7a7792c9ecd8c6b45f254772254b.png[/img]

[b][i]MYSTIC A // Code Name:[/i] DEMONIC ALTAR[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/56c66cf7c2cb153d119eba117937b4f232b7803e.png[/img]

Everyone is a fan of the Demon and you got to strongly consider this Psycore if you want to build a Burn deck!

[quote=Victor]"The Starter of this deck will be a constant source of Burning, perfect to trigger effects tied to it."[/quote]

And if you want to play around with the idea of summons or ability, then you have another option.

[b][i]MYSTIC B // Code Name:[/i] SUMMONING ALTAR[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/74be15b6fa3b8f1ba86f66b7bfcbf3c6d6763f79.png[/img]

This Psycore is very efficient if you want to play around with Activated abilities as well as Summons. Your Starter will be able to trigger effects with Activated Abilities while creating a nice little Summon that can be further boosted.

[quote=Victor]"Or sacrificed for good trades or even to draw!"[/quote]

Exactly Victor! I think we actually went through all the psycores!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42982631/c7c4036f38af7d15efce3c11f6db894626572bb6.png[/img]

All 6 genes have 2 Psycores at the moment which offer a lot of possibility for your deck building. And nothing tells us that future Pyscores might not be developed by the corporations!

[quote=Victor]"And we'll be here to tell you all about it!"[/quote]

See you soon Psycogs!

notes.title: Season 3 Balance Patch
notes.content:
Hello Psycogs!

Here is the next balancing patch that will be live on Wednesday, October 4. As usual, here are a few words from the Dev team to find out more, as well as the list of Buffs and Nerfs. 

Let's dive right in!

[b][h2]Objectives[/h2][/b]

2023’s season 2 was far more balanced, at least in terms of deck diversity. However, Zoo decks (and at a lesser scale, Tech decks) still have a dominating presence in the PvP scene over the others, and Mystic decks are the least favored child.

[b][h3]Downward balancing (Nerfs)[/h3][/b]

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Beast[/b]
[list]
[*] The Zoo Psycore based on the Beast starter keeps on being the most played Starter since season 1. Its ability do deal damage on the opposing battlefield (even if a bit unreliably) makes it often a first choice starter, overshadowing most basic Zoo mutants. We chose to weaken it by making it far more random and risky, in the line of Zoo’s randomness. 
[/list]

[b]Midnight Fangs Ability[/b]
[i]BEFORE[/i]
When this mutant enters play/evolves, it deals [1-1-1-2-3] damage to a random opposing entity. 

[i]AFTER[/i]
When this mutant enters play/evolves, it deals [1-1-1-2-3] damage to another random entity on your or your opponent’s battlefield.

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Scrap-Metal Cannon[/b]
[list]
[*] The Scrap-Metal Cannon is too efficient in its ability to target and destroy the opposing Psycore, bypassing Guardian Buildings and Mutants. To limit that card’s power in PvP and Siege battles, we make it able to target only Mutants. 
[/list]

[i]BEFORE[/i]
Discard any number of Tech mutants or Parts cards. Deal 2 piercing damage to target entity for each discarded card. 

[i]AFTER[/i]
Discard any number of Tech mutants or Parts cards. Deal 2 piercing damage to target mutant for each discarded card. 

Note : The Scrap-Metal cannon still works on the Battle Simulacrum, as it’s a Mutant. 

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Laser Printer[/b]
[list]
[*] The Laser Printer is a very effective Building to fill your board with Starter mutants. We limit its long-term generation so that the Old Printer remains a viable alternative.
[/list]

New stats : HP reduced from [3] to [2]

___________________________________________________________________

[b][h3]Upward balancing (Buffs)[/h3][/b]

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Cerberus[/b]
[list]
[*] Cerberus was lightly understatted, we upped its ATK in consequence. 
[/list]

New stats : ATK increased from [1-3-4-6-7] to [2-4-5-7-8]

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Dilophoraptor[/b]
[list]
[*] We determined temporary ATK penalties were not as powerful as we expected them to be, so we make them permanent. 
[/list]

[b]Blinding Toxin ability[/b]
[i]BEFORE[/i]
When this mutant enters play/evolves, inflict -[1-2-2-3-100] ATK on a random oppposing mutant until the end of turn.

[i]AFTER[/i]
When this mutant enters play/evolves, inflict -[1-2-2-3-100] ATK on a random oppposing mutant.

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Wicked Witch[/b]
[list]
[*] As per Dilophoraptor, we make its ATK penalty permanent, without changing its stats, while adjusting the ability power at Platinum rank, as this one was already permanent. 
[/list]

[b]Murder of Crows ability:[/b]
[i]BEFORE[/i]
Action - The target enemy mutant and all mutants on the same battlefield are inflicted with -[1-1-2-2] ATK until the end of turn.
Platine : Action - The target enemy mutant and all mutants on the same battlefield are inflicted with -[2] ATK.

[i]AFTER[/i]
Action - The target enemy mutant and all mutants on the same battlefield are inflicted with  -[1-1-2-2-3] ATK.

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Wrath[/b]
[list]
[*] Wrath was lightly understatted, and had a low survivability in most cases. We increase its HP at all ranks.
[/list]

New stats : HP increased from [2-3-5-7-9] to [3-4-6-8-10]

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Stealth Bot[/b]
[list]
[*] This mutant had a very situational ability. We decided to add it a small Stasis effect at Basic and Bronze ranks to both align it with other ranks and make its evolution more understandable.
[*] 
[/list]
The Backstab and Electric Backstab abilities are merged into one. 
[i]BEFORE[/i]

Action - Deal [1-2-2-3-4] and Stasis [0-0-2-2-2] to target mutant. Stealth-Bot loses Evasion until the beginning of your next turn. 

[i]AFTER[/i]

Action - Deal [1-2-2-3-4] and Stasis [1-1-2-2-2] to target mutant. Stealth-Bot loses Evasion until the beginning of your next turn. 

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Set Ablaze[/b]
[list]
[*] Even though that card’s power level on the long term was quite correct (6 damage over 3 turns), the card suffered greatly in comparison with all other forms of single-target direct damage or destruction. We increased its offensive ability to give it the ability to exert long-term pressure on powerful mutants.
[*] 
[/list]

[i]BEFORE[/i]

Discard a Mystic Mutant: Inflict Burning 3 to target mutant.

[i]AFTER[/i]

Discard a Mystic Mutant: Inflict Burning 4 to target mutant.

___________________________________________________________________

[b]The Forgotten One[/b]
[list]
[*] This Heroic Necro mutant has been part of the forgotten ones (pun intended) during this ranked season. We decided to improve it by simplifying her Eternal Despair ability, which now applies both stat increases when a mutant is destroyed, and we gave her a brand new effect. We adjusted its stats accordingly.
[/list]

New Stats: HP reduced from [9] to [8]

[b]Eternal Despair ability[/b]

[i]BEFORE[/i]
Whenever a mutant you control is destroyed, this mutant has +1 ATK. Whenever an opposing mutant is destroyed, this mutant has +1 HP.

[i]AFTER[/i]

Whenever another mutant is destroyed on your or your opponent’s battlefield, this mutant has +1 ATK, +1 PV and your Psycore is healed by 1.

___________________________________________________________________


[h3][b]Mechanical changes (Reworks)[/b][/h3]

___________________________________________________________________


[b]Monocerus[/b]
[list]
[*] Monocerus has been part of the most played mutants since the first ranked season, despite a first modification of its ability. Given the huge number of Zoo/Tech Basic mutants, we decided to change Monocerus to an advanced mutant, in order to balance the distribution of such mutants. Its stats have been rebalanced according to the new design. 
[/list]

Mutant Subtype: Basic → Advanced

[b]New Stats:[/b]

Evolution Curve: EVO necessary to evolve : Increased from [1-2-3-4] to [2-3-4-5]

EVO given on destruction : Increased from [1-2-3-4-6] to [2-3-4-6-9]

ATK: Reduced from [2-3-5-8-10] to [2-3-4-6-8]

HP: Increased [2-3-6-9-11] to [3-5-7-10-12]


That's it for this patch, don't forget that it will be available wednesday 4th of october!

Have a great game,

Team Genesis.
